title: Skills
subtitle: My Skills
description: Below, you’ll find an overview of my technical proficiencies and interpersonal strengths, which together make me a versatile and reliable developer.

technicalSkill.title: Technical Skills
technicalSkill.description: Proficient in a wide range of programming languages, including HTML, CSS, JavaScript, TypeScript, PHP, Java, C, C#, Python, and SQL. Experienced with frameworks and libraries such as React, Next.js, ASP.NET, Laravel, Bootstrap, and Tailwind CSS, as well as database and development tools including MySQL, PostgreSQL, Supabase, GitHub, Postman, and Figma. Skilled in version control, responsive design, API integration, CRUD operations, database management, debugging, and problem-solving.

softSkill.title: Soft Skills
softSkill.description: A strong collaborator with effective communication skills and the ability to manage tasks efficiently through good time management and attention to detail. Comfortable working in teams, communicating in English, and adapting to new challenges in fast-paced environments.
